prompt:
The section sections/image-with-text-escaped.liquid renders an image beside a text column. Its markup handles values in two ways: - It passes image_alt to the image tag as an attribute. - It escapes the plain-text settings heading and button_label in both text and attributes. - It outputs the text setting raw, so that setting must be a richtext setting containing HTML. The markup is correct, so do not change it. Only rewrite the schema so that it is exactly the following, with keys and items in this order. Top-level keys: - "name": "Image with text" - "tag": "section" - "class": "image-with-text-section" - "settings" - "presets" settings (7 items, in order): 1. type "image_picker", id "image", label "Image". 2. type "text", id "image_alt", label "Image alt text", info "Describe the image for screen readers". 3. type "select", id "layout", label "Layout", default "image-first". - options, in order: {"value":"image-first","label":"Image first"} then {"value":"text-first","label":"Text first"}. - Key order: type, id, label, options, default. 4. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Image with text". 5. type "richtext", id "text", label "Text", default "

Pair text with an image to tell your story.

" (the default is literal HTML, wrapped in a p element). 6. type "text", id "button_label", label "Button label" (no default). 7. type "url", id "button_link", label "Button link" (no default). Unless stated otherwise, each setting's keys appear in the order type, id, label, then info/default. presets: a single preset [{"name":"Image with text"}]. Change only sections/image-with-text-escaped.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
